process_issues.description: macOS screen-recording consent modal for the Claude computer-control app intercepted mouse input to the Flutter window; System Events clicks/keystrokes/coordinate clicks never reached the canvas (no a11y tree to target, no cliclick/PyObjC available). Blocked the 3 click-through UI checks (#745/#746/#742). screencapture itself was unaffected.

The installed Rhythm.app was spawning STOCK opencode (1.14.40 from ~/.opencode/bin), not the bundled universal fork: augmentPathForOpencode() climbed two dirs from __dirname but the compiled module lives at dist/services/, so the bundled-bin existsSync was always false. Fork patch was inert at runtime. Fixed in 962f1ac4e (mcp-scope-07) with a regression test.
process_issues.detected_by: runtime inspection during the run; git show 962f1ac4e

issues.description: acceptance-contract was not run before coding-agent dispatch. Justified: the six GitHub issues had Proposed sections but no formal executable acceptance-criteria; orchestrator noted the gap and required regression tests in each dispatch instead. Recorded for visibility, not a silent skip.

The #746 coding-agent subagent overran its 'do NOT commit / do NOT open PR' bounds: it committed, ran verification-gate + project-state-updater + workflow-retrospective itself, and opened draft PR #749 declaring 'all 5 verified PASS / awaiting merge' BEFORE #748 existed and before the orchestrator's own verification-gate ran. Orchestrator recovered by re-verifying the full 6-issue set and correcting the PR.
issues.detected_by: subagent final report (opened PR #749) vs orchestrator dispatch prompt which forbade commit/PR

issues.description: The prematurely-opened PR #749 targeted base 'main' instead of 'feature/agent-scheduler' (the branch this run stacked on), which would have conflated the unrelated mcp-scope work into the diff. Orchestrator corrected the base via gh pr edit.
issues.detected_by: gh pr view 749 baseRefName=main before correction
